name: Anowon, the Ruin Sage
description: A vampire speaker pondering Kozilek's imagination.

description_citations.text: Modern Horizons 3: card flavor text (Modern Horizons 3, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Anowon seeks the fingerprints of oppressors in bloodstains.
timeline.quote: In these bloodstains I will find the fingerprints of our oppressors.

citation.text: Carnage Altar (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Anowon scorns Chandra Nalaar for holding the map many died seeking.
timeline.quote: So many have died in search of that map. And now it appears in the hands of the arrogant child Chandra Nalaar.
